venue.address: 〒120-0005 東京都足立区綾瀬1-34-7-102 (1-34-7-102, Ayase, Adachi, Tokyo)

items.information: 東京，綾瀬駅より徒歩3分の足立区勤労福祉会館にて，ルービックキューブの公式大会を開催します。 開催種目は， ・3x3x3 キューブ 4ラウンド ・2x2x2 キューブ 2ラウンド ・3x3x3 片手 2ラウンド ・3x3x3 目隠し 1ラウンド の4種目となります。特に3x3x3キューブは記録更新のチャンス，ぜひご参加ください。 ※3x3x3キューブの参加者数が100人に満たない場合，3ラウンド開催となります。 WCA official competition is held near Ayase Sta. in Tokyo. We have * 4 rounds for 3x3x3 * 2 rounds for 2x2x2, 3x3x3 one-handed * 1 round for 3x3x3 blindfolded as its events. It is chance to break your record especially in 3x3x3! Let's come to our competition to take a chance! ※3x3x3 will be 3 rounds if the number of competitors for the event is less than 100.

venue.name: Auditório da Administração, UFPR, Centro Politécnico
venue.address: R. Cel Francisco H Dos Santos, 1180 - Jardim das Americas, Curitiba - PR, 81530-200, Brasil

items.information: **PORTUGUESE** A competição é reconhecida pela Associação Mundial de Cubo Mágico (WCA) e os resultados farão parte dos rankings oficiais. Teremos premiações (medalhas) para os três primeiros colocados de cada modalidade. Contamos com a colaboração de TODOS para tornar a competição mais fluida. Portanto, quando solicitado, prontifique-se para ser juiz, embaralhador ou runner. **ENGLISH** The competitions is aknowledged by the World Cube Association (WCA) and the results will be ranked officially. There will be prizes (medals) for the first three best results in each event. We count on EVERYBODY's collaboration to make this competition more fluid. Therefore, when asked, please be ready to be a judge, scrambler or runner.

items.information: All competitors should be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
